During [[Yaru Korsin]]'s reign as [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], this '''Keshiri''' was a vocal and prominent dissenter from the commonly accepted idea that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were divine. As a means to reassure the faith of the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] people, the dissenter was brought out to preach in the [[Circle Eternal]] plaza of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]], only to die, seemingly [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|choking]] to death on his own words.
